'''Buckflower Plot''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|To use this plot, follow the steps of fine cultivation and harvest the ripened crops to get plenty of Buckflowers and a higher chance of Firebuckle.|A cultivation plot with various parameters adjusted for growing Buckflowers. Overall soil quality of the plot is far better than that of the average arable land in Valley IV.}}
